text: Design 1 noticed planted English only at even odds. Design 2 runs sixteen searches side by side at different boldness, swapping states, the usual remedy when the true answer sits in a narrow pit among many false ones.
8 planted texts at length 23, each against 6 shuffles of its own letters that still fit the known letters; the same compute per text as design 1.
6 of 8 beat all their own copies (luck gives 1.1; bar 6): design 2 passes. Still no planted text recovered; it notices English it cannot read.
